creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`muster pane send --pane

--enter` with no text exits 2: "the following required arguments were not provided: ...". The usage line, `muster pane send [OPTIONS] [TEXT]...`, shows TEXT as optional, and pressing Return alone is what an agent needs when a menu or dialog wants one more Return. `muster pane send --pane

'' --enter` works, but nothing says so. ## Measured: 2026-10-01, usage line unchanged in 0.13.0 A laptop agent was ending Claude Code sessions in devenv panes with `/exit`. In one pane `/exit` opened the slash-command menu and needed one more Return. `--enter` alone was refused, and `'' --enter` delivered it. On 2026-10-05 an agent could not take the default of a Codex approval prompt with a bare Return for the same reason (a_2cW56wz6X). ## Things that might be true - **Let `--enter` with no TEXT press Return alone.** - Or show TEXT as required in the usage line, and give `''` for a bare Return in `muster docs agents`.
title: pane send --enter alone is refused, though its usage shows TEXT as optional
